augmentation.implementation_gate: Before training, prove an implementation over stored v2H tensors is numerically equivalent to the frozen source-lattice operation; otherwise apply the transform on the frozen A 512 and B 16 lattices before sizing. Do not pre-materialize random views.
augmentation.recipe: v2F deterministic D4 keyed by SHA256 UTF-8 Dataset-v2F|augment|2026102303|physical_object_id|zero_based_epoch; first 8 bytes big endian modulo 8. Codes 0–3 are quarter-turn CCW; 4–7 mirror horizontally then rotate.

author_decisions_status: all five author gates explicitly resolved and frozen

custom_input_adapter.custom_architecture_contract: unchanged effective v1 architecture with 256x256 input; do not change to grid 7
custom_input_adapter.order: load frozen v2H tensor; apply frozen training-only D4 augmentation (validation/test identity); apply adapter; transfer to CUDA; call custom model

data_and_preprocessing.class_weights: Reciprocal training-object counts by class, float32, normalized by float32 mean; computed from train labels only and shared across all families/representations.
data_and_preprocessing.normalization: Use v2H per-object p01/p99, clipping, asinh(10), and fixed (u-0.5)/0.5 exactly. No additional fitted image normalization. Any metadata imputation/scaling uses training objects only.
data_and_preprocessing.source: v2H tensors only; one object-level example with blue/red/NIR channel order

determinism.DataLoader: seeded generator, deterministic worker initialization, fixed shuffle algorithm; validation and test order do not shuffle
determinism.cuda: CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8; deterministic algorithms and cuDNN deterministic; benchmark false; TF32 disabled
determinism.seed_unit: same numeric seed matches corresponding architecture/configuration/representation runs; seeds are training replicates, not an inferential n=3 sample

custom_cnn_transformer.policy: Seeded source-defined initialization; no checkpoint reuse. Preserve effective v1 architecture and 256x256 input contract; apply frozen non-trainable adapter described in custom_input_adapter.

initialization.normalization: Use exact frozen v2H normalization; no additional ImageNet-specific or family-specific normalization.

resnet50.policy: Official locally preserved torchvision ResNet50_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1 bytes only; verify SHA-256 before use; no network; missing/mismatched bytes stop execution.

initialization.transfer_interpretation: Frozen transfer-learning policy. Blue/red/NIR are not conventional RGB channels; this does not assert spectral equivalence.

vit_b_16.policy: Official locally preserved torchvision ViT_B_16_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1 bytes only; verify SHA-256 before use; no network; missing/mismatched bytes stop execution.

metadata_FOV_control.imputation_and_scaling: training objects only; median imputation and centering/scaling; no held-out fitting
metadata_FOV_control.purpose: mandatory leakage/shortcut control; never selects representations or model configs

model_selection.checkpoint_within_fit: Minimum sample-mean class-weighted validation loss; retain all three seeds; never select a best seed.
model_selection.search: 90 fits on representation A only: 12 ResNet50 configs x 3 seeds; 12 ViT-B/16 configs x 3 seeds; six custom Transformer configs x 3 seeds.
model_selection.selection_rule: Per architecture, choose one configuration using only A validation: highest mean balanced accuracy over three seeds; then highest mean macro-F1; then lowest mean weighted validation loss; then lowest sample variance (ddof=1) of balanced accuracy; then lexicographically smallest configuration ID.
model_selection.winner_controls: After selection, run only B, A_outer and B_outer for the selected configuration and all three matching seeds; do not rerun the selected A fits.

optimization_proposal.checkpoint_and_resume: Save epoch-boundary last state including model, optimizer, scheduler, RNG and sampler states; preserve best state at minimum sample-mean weighted validation loss. Resume only from hash-verified complete state with identical configuration, protocol, source and environment. Never restart due to poor performance or reset optimizer/scheduler.
optimization_proposal.failure: OOM, nondeterminism, missing pretrained weights, corrupt state or nonfinite loss stops the fit/campaign. No batch, precision, seed, preprocessing, architecture or optimizer changes to rescue a run; no replacement fit without new authorization.

resource_limits.memory: record peak allocated/reserved; stop at 90% of device memory; no batch fallback
resource_limits.one_exclusive_GPU: RTX 5060 Ti class as in v1 execution; no concurrent fits
resource_limits.precision: float32 only; CUDA deterministic settings inherited from v1
resource_limits.software_target: Python 3.12.3; torch 2.7.0+cu128; torchvision 0.22.0+cu128; freeze full environment/source digest before launch

optimization_proposal.weighted_loss: class-weighted cross-entropy; mean reduction over objects

statistical_analysis.bootstrap_unit: resample 61 assignment units with replacement; keep all objects in each unit; same draw for every paired model, representation and seed
statistical_analysis.metadata_control: Report both fixed metadata models and paired cluster-bootstrap differences versus each primary A architecture descriptively; no representation selection or tuning from these controls.
statistical_analysis.metric_conventions: balanced accuracy averages recall over classes with positive true support; macro-F1 includes all four frozen classes with zero when denominator is zero; report degeneracies/support explicitly
statistical_analysis.multiplicity: Holm alpha .05: 9 primary A architecture-pair×metric tests; separate 27-test family for architecture contrasts on controls and separate 27-test family for each control versus A.
statistical_analysis.randomization_unit: assignment unit; jointly swap model predictions for every object in a sampled unit
statistical_analysis.seed_summary: report seed-specific metrics and paired differences; report every seed and mean ± sample SD (ddof=1); never best seed
